text:
Maria: Quick heads up — we rolled the microburst adaptive-KV prefetch into a 10% canary this morning.
Maria: Early numbers look promising: p50 latency down ~18% and p99 down ~12% on the small-chat workload, throughput steady, and unit cost ~9% lower for 1k-token sessions.
Sam: Whoa, nice. Is that across both regions and mixed traffic or synthetic only?
Maria: Canary traffic was real prod-like (10% routed across us-west-2 + eu-west-1), plus synthetic regression runs for long-contexts.
Kevin: Can you paste the bench table? makes it easier to digest.
Maria: Here are the summary numbers from the dashboard snapshot:
```
workload           p50_before p50_after p99_before p99_after cost_per_1k_before cost_per_1k_after
chat-small         42ms       34ms      230ms      203ms      $0.024            $0.022
chat-medium        65ms       58ms      410ms      395ms      $0.031            $0.029
long-context (8k)  180ms      185ms     950ms      980ms      $0.060            $0.061
```
Maria: Notes: long-context shows a tiny p99 tail regression (~3%) — we introduced a timebox flush at 300ms to limit KV churn which explains the tradeoff.
Anya: Any impact on embeddings or reranking routes?
Maria: No significant delta on embeddings or rerank suites in the 24h canary sample. We intentionally disabled adaptive prefetch for embedding workers (flagged off by default) until we validate more.
Sam: What are the rollback/guardrails if something goes sideways?
Maria: Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 30% after 1h (if no alerts) -> 60% over 6h -> 100% next day. Auto-rollback triggers: p99 >= 1.5x baseline OR token cost regression >5% for >30min OR error-rate spike >0.2%.
Maria: I've wired alerts to #eng-monitoring and added a temporary annotation in release notes. I'll be watching the dashboards for the first 3 hours.
Kevin: Can you add the canary graphs to the release thread and a short changelog blurb? We'll want this in the weeklies.
Maria: Yep — will post the dashboard links and put a short summary in the release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: microburst-adaptive-kv v3 -> canary (10%) at 2025-11-07T09:12:03Z
Anya: Thanks — I'll be on-call for the first window, ping me if it starts to trend.
Sam: :thumbsup: Great work, team.
Kevin: Nice win — nice balance of cost vs tail tradeoffs. Let's capture the long-context regression in a follow-up perf task.
Maria: Agreed. Creating a ticket for follow-up experiments (adaptive timeboxing heuristics + targeted prefetch exceptions).
